reason: This plugin is primarily a DSH plugin-management tool for end users: it exposes a settings UI flow plus host APIs to separate built-in and custom plugins, import and register custom plugins, enable/disable/delete them, and migrate existing installed plugins into a dedicated custom directory. Its behavior is local to DSH plugin administration and profile configuration with optional dependency/conflict checks.

summaries.zh: 该插件用于在 DSH 设置中按官方与自定义分区管理插件，并支持浏览目录、导入、注册、开启/关闭、删除与历史插件收纳。
summaries.en: This plugin lets users manage DSH plugins by separating built-in and custom plugins, browsing their directories, importing/registering plugins, enabling/disabling them, deleting entries, and migrating legacy custom plugins.

capabilities: Manage plugin metadata and directories for custom plugins in local DSH profiles
Provide local web APIs for plugin state, import, registration, toggle, removal, and migration actions
Import plugins from Git/local paths/npm package names and integrate with existing DSH plugin management commands
Check dependencies/conflicts for custom plugins and perform related recommendations/repair actions locally
Open and operate local plugin directories from the settings interface

reasons.code: README states the plugin splits DSH plugin list into built-in and custom sections and stores custom plugins under ~/.dsh/custom-plugins.
README and package metadata describe plugin actions for browse/import/register/toggle/remove and migration of legacy plugins, indicating direct profile/plugin lifecycle management.
Working principle section documents host-side Node APIs and routes such as /plugins/dsh-plugin-optimization/api/{state,open,import,register,toggle,remove,migrate}.
README says import supports git/local path/npm name, which implies fetching/processing external plugin sources.
Package description mentions dependency checking and conflict-related repair for plugin startup errors, indicating automated operational behavior.
